process_area.title: Privacy Governance, Consent & Data Subject Rights Fulfillment

value_stream.name: Consumer Data Privacy & Data Protection Program

fields.Participants: DPO, Legal, Compliance, IT Security, HR, Marketing, Customer Service
fields.Trigger: Program setup, annual review, or regulatory change

workflows.name: Data Privacy Program Governance, NPC Registration & DPO Operations

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-renew of "renewal for all 5 legal entities and personal-data processing" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reports to board" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documentation per processing activity" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-153 (ensure privacy consent, DSAR & processor oversight.)
- operational: dedicated DPO and steering committee
Pain Points / Risks: - **Governance risk**: Program under-resourced or fragmented; mitigated by dedicated DPO and steering committee
System Touchpoints: - Privacy policy/notice CMS; NPC registration record; board reporting (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: DPO maintains the privacy program: charter, privacy policy, data governance framework, and NPC registration/renewal for all 5 legal entities and personal-data processing
DPO chairs the Privacy Steering Committee (Legal, IT Security, HR, Marketing, CX); sets risk appetite, priorities, and resourcing; reports to board (links to VS-36)
DPO maintains privacy policy and notices across touchpoints (web/app, store signage, loyalty enrollment, CCTV) and ensures lawful-basis documentation per processing activity

fields.Participants: DPO, IT, Data Governance, Business Process Owners
fields.Trigger: Initial build, new processing, or annual refresh

workflows.name: Personal Data Inventory, Data Mapping & Records of Processing Activities (ROPA)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validate ROPA accuracy" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-502 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Governance, Consent & Data Subject Rights Fulfillment (PA-91.1).)
- operational: data flow mapping and process-owner validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Shadow-data risk**: Undocumented data copies defeat DSAR/erasure; mitigated by data flow mapping and process-owner validation
System Touchpoints: - ROPA register; data flow/catalog (links to VS-29/VS-28); privacy metadata

steps.activity: DPO/Data Governance build/maintain ROPA: data category, source, purpose, lawful basis, recipients, retention, cross-border transfer, processor — per processing activity
IT maps data flows across systems (POS, ecommerce, loyalty/CRM, app, marketplace, CCTV, AP/AR, payroll-adjacent); identifies storage, integrations, and copies
Business Process Owners validate ROPA accuracy; DPO publishes and maintains as living register; supports DSAR (W3044) and PIA (W3049)

fields.Participants: Marketing Tech, DPO, Loyalty/CRM, IT, Ecommerce
fields.Trigger: Customer data collection / signup / preference change

workflows.name: Consent Capture, Preference Management & Lawful Basis Tracking

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "record timestamp and version" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "center allowing customer self-service changes" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-flag of "flags processing without valid consent/legitimate-interest assessment" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-153 (ensure privacy consent, DSAR & processor oversight.)
- operational: granular consent capture and quarterly audit
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unlawful-processing risk**: Marketing without valid consent; mitigated by granular consent capture and quarterly audit
System Touchpoints: - Consent/preference center; loyalty/CRM (links to VS-13); cross-channel preference sync; email/SMS platforms

steps.activity: Marketing Tech/Loyalty capture consent at enrollment/checkout with granular purpose flags (marketing, profiling, third-party share, location); record timestamp and version
IT maintains consent/preference center allowing customer self-service changes; syncs preferences across channels (POS, web, app, CRM, email/SMS)
DPO audits consent records for lawful-basis coverage; flags processing without valid consent/legitimate-interest assessment; remediates

fields.Participants: DPO, Customer Service, IT, Business Process Owners, Legal

workflows.name: Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) Fulfillment & Verification

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Customer Service/DPO log DSAR" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews for third-party data" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "updates DSAR register" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-153 (ensure privacy consent, DSAR & processor oversight.)
- operational: case tracking and cross-system retrieval runbooks; operational: retrieval runbooks
Pain Points / Risks: - **SLA risk**: Missing statutory fulfillment window; mitigated by case tracking and cross-system retrieval runbooks
System Touchpoints: - DSAR case register; data retrieval across systems (links to VS-29); secure delivery
Time Estimate: - Per request; fulfill within statutory window

steps.activity: Customer Service/DPO log DSAR; verify subject identity (anti-fraud); acknowledge within statutory window; route to relevant data custodians
IT/Business Process Owners retrieve all personal data held (per ROPA W3042) across systems; compile response package; DPO reviews for third-party data
DPO delivers response to subject securely; logs fulfillment; updates DSAR register; coordinates related rectification/erasure (W3045)

fields.Participants: DPO, IT, Business Process Owners, Legal, Records
fields.Trigger: Subject requests correction, deletion, or objection to processing

workflows.name: Data Rectification, Erasure & Objection Request Processing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-request of "DPO assesses request" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "records subject to legal hold or BIR/SEC retention" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "logs and confirms completion" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-502 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Governance, Consent & Data Subject Rights Fulfillment (PA-91.1).)
- operational: ROPA-driven processor notification and verification
Pain Points / Risks: - **Incomplete-erasure risk**: Copies retained by processors; mitigated by ROPA-driven processor notification and verification
System Touchpoints: - Rectification/erasure workflow; legal hold (links to VS-88); processor notification; DSAR register

steps.activity: DPO assesses request: rectification (correct inaccurate), erasure (delete where no lawful basis/legal hold), objection (stop specific processing)
IT/Process Owners execute correction/deletion across systems and processor copies; preserve records subject to legal hold or BIR/SEC retention (links to VS-88)
DPO notifies subject of action; notifies third-party recipients of rectification/erasure obligation; logs and confirms completion

workflows.name: Marketing Consent, Unsubscribe & Communication Preference Sync

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-sync of "sync preference to CRM and suppress from future campaigns" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate audience against consent before send" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System continuous audit of "audits unsubscribe compliance and frequency-cap adherence" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-502 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Governance, Consent & Data Subject Rights Fulfillment (PA-91.1).)
- operational: real-time sync and pre-send validation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Spam-complaint risk**: Slow unsubscribe or cross-channel leakage triggers complaints; mitigated by real-time sync and pre-send validation
System Touchpoints: - Preference/suppression sync (links to VS-13); campaign consent enforcement; complaint handling

steps.activity: Marketing Ops honor unsubscribe/opt-out immediately across email/SMS/push; sync preference to CRM and suppress from future campaigns
Marketing Ops enforce campaign-level consent and suppression lists; validate audience against consent before send; prevent unsolicited messaging
DPO audits unsubscribe compliance and frequency-cap adherence; investigates complaints; remediates systemic issues

workflows.name: Loyalty Member Data Portability & Account Data Export

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "Customer Service/DPO receive portability request" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "generate machine-readable export" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "DPO delivers export securely" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-502 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Governance, Consent & Data Subject Rights Fulfillment (PA-91.1).)
- operational: portability scope definition (subject-provided data only)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scope risk**: Over/under-delivery of data; mitigated by portability scope definition (subject-provided data only)
System Touchpoints: - Data export tooling; loyalty/CRM data (links to VS-13); secure delivery

steps.activity: Customer Service/DPO receive portability request; verify identity; scope data provided-to-subject (purchase history, profile, preferences the subject provided)
IT/Loyalty generate machine-readable export (structured, common format) of subject-provided data; DPO excludes third-party/inferred data per portability scope
DPO delivers export securely; logs fulfillment; supports subject transfer to another controller

fields.Participants: DPO, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Service
fields.Trigger: Processing involving minors or sensitive/special-category data

workflows.name: Minors' Data, Sensitive Data & Special Category Processing Controls

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify processing involving minors" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documents lawful basis" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-153 (ensure privacy consent, DSAR & processor oversight.)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Heightened-risk data exposure**: Sensitive data breach carries severe consequences; mitigated by minimization and enhanced controls
System Touchpoints: - Enhanced access controls (links to VS-27); encryption; consent with explicit flag; retention override

steps.activity: DPO/Legal identify processing involving minors (e.g., student/community programs) or sensitive data (health-related wellness, biometrics, government IDs); apply heightened controls
IT/Process Owners apply enhanced controls: explicit consent, access restriction, encryption, minimization, and shorter retention for sensitive data
DPO audits special-category processing for compliance; restricts use; documents lawful basis (consent or limited legitimate grounds)
